_说明: 透明路线（qwen21-edit-2k-rgba）：输入是透明背景的 RGBA（front.png 由绿幕图经 key_unmix 抠出），输出也要透明背景。由 front-edit-prompts.json 去掉绿幕说法、加透明背景句得到。2026-10-09。

E1_blankface.prompt: Edit <image1>: erase the eyes, the eyebrows, the eyelashes, the mouth and the blush from the face, leaving a completely blank smooth skin face with the same face outline and skin color. Keep everything else exactly the same: same pose, same position, same size, hair, dress and body unchanged. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E2_closed.prompt: Edit <image1>: the character gently closes both eyes (relaxed closed eyelids drawn as soft curved lash lines, like a blink). Keep everything else exactly the same: same eyebrows, same small smile, same pose, same position and size, same hair and dress. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E3_mouth_ah.prompt: Edit <image1>: the character opens her mouth wide as if saying "ah" cheerfully, showing the inside of the mouth and a bit of tongue. Keep everything else exactly the same: same open eyes, same eyebrows, same pose, same position and size, same hair and dress. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E4_happy.prompt: Edit <image1>: give the character a very happy expression: eyes closed in happy upward arcs (^ ^ shape), big open smile, light pink blush on the cheeks. Keep everything else exactly the same: same pose, same position and size, same hair and dress. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E5_noarms.prompt: Edit <image1>: remove both arms completely, including the short sleeves and the hands, as if the character were a dress form. Complete the sides of the dress bodice and the skirt where the arms and hands used to cover them, with clean shoulders. Keep the head, hair, dress, legs and shoes exactly the same, same position and size. Leave it transparent where the arms were. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E6_hair.prompt: Edit <image1>: keep only the hair, as a separate wig seen from the front. Remove the face, the neck, the body, the dress, the arms and the legs, and fill the area where the face was with the back inner side of the same pink hair (darker pink), so the hair is one complete piece. Same hair shape, position, size and colors. Everything else transparent. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E8_bald._说明: §13.6 方案 A：在空白脸 E1 上去掉全部头发，补出完整的脸（自带轮廓线、额头、脸侧、耳朵）作脸层；头发层改为原图 − 本图的差分。2026-10-09。
E8_bald.prompt: Edit <image1>: remove all of the hair completely (the bangs, the side hair, the back hair and the hair clip), revealing the bare head underneath: a smooth bald scalp in the same skin color, the complete forehead, the full face outline on both sides drawn with the same thin line art, and both ears. Keep the face blank without eyes or mouth. Keep the neck, the dress, the arms and the legs exactly the same, same pose, same position and same size. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

E7_legs.prompt: Edit <image1>: keep only the two legs and the shoes. Remove the head, hair, dress, arms and upper body. Draw the legs fully up to the hips as plain skin-colored thighs (like a mannequin's legs, no underwear details), same leg shape, position, size and skin color, same shoes. Everything else transparent. This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.
